Class OnPickingEffects

java.lang.Object
model.cards.buildingCards.buildingEffects.onPickingEffects.OnPickingEffects
All Implemented Interfaces:
BuildingEffect
public class OnPickingEffects extends Object implements BuildingEffect
Implements an immediate execution strategy for building effects activated upon card acquisition.

This class leverages functional composition via a Consumer callback to perform structural mutations directly onto the player's domain model at the exact moment the card is picked. By injecting specialized behavior blocks (lambdas) via the BuildingCardFactory, it seamlessly configures diverse player-scoped capabilities—such as toggling passive flags (e.g., shamanic immunity, extra draws, or totem resource modifiers)—eliminating the architectural overhead of maintaining individual concrete subclasses for simple state mutations.

* @author Vincenzo Parente
